detailed_description:
A polished dark-tech product infographic rendered in a clean, high-contrast digital style with cool blue and purple neon accents on a matte black surface. The composition is a top-down flat-lay of a processor chip centered on a circuit board, with a title block above and four feature cards below, all held static while the background animates.

[Shot 1] The frame opens on the full infographic composition: the central processor chip <Subject 1> sits at the center of the dark textured circuit board <Subject 2>, its brushed-metal top face catching soft overhead light and its blue LED ring glowing steadily. The title block <Subject 3> reads "MiniMax H3" on the first line and "多参全能整合工作流 V2" on the second line in bold white type with subtle blue underline strokes. Below the chip, four rounded-rectangle icon cards <Subject 4> are arranged in a horizontal row, each displaying a blue line-art icon and a Chinese caption: "10种生成模式", "提示词优化", "lantent 二阶采样", "turbo  加速". Beneath the cards, the caption line <Subject 5] reads "参考图 | 音频 | 潜空间 | 加速采样" in small white characters. The camera holds a fixed top-down view with no movement. The circuit-board background <Subject 2] animates: neon light pulses travel along the branching blue, purple, and violet traces radiating outward from the chip, creating a slow rhythmic flow of illumination that moves from the center outward and back, giving the board a living, data-flowing quality. The chip <Subject 1] remains perfectly still and in focus; the LED ring maintains a steady blue glow with a very subtle breathing intensity. All text elements <Subject 3], <Subject 4], and <Subject 5] remain perfectly static and legible, with no movement, scaling, or repositioning. The four icon cards <Subject 4] keep their positions, sizes, and internal icons fixed. The overall lighting is even and cool, with the neon traces providing the only dynamic light source. The shot runs for the full 15 seconds as a single continuous fixed-camera take, with the background animation providing gentle, looping motion while the foreground infographic elements remain locked in place.
